source: at TRACE, 8.0.0's SniHandler logs `found ALPN protocol:{}` for the protocol a TLS handshake negotiated (none for a client that offers no ALPN, such as MockServer's own HTTP/1.1 forwarding client) and `no client certificate chain as client did not complete mTLS` each time it asks for the client's certificates and finds none: on HTTP/1.1 once for the codec's set-up and once for the connection's first request (EarlyMatchingHandler), not for later requests on it.; socketConnectionTimeoutInMillis bounds the first handshake, whose certificate generation can take over the default 20 s on a loaded machine

steps.note: a TLS connection first, so the CA loads are behind us

GET /ncc/b HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

steps.note: two requests on one TLS connection (ALPN http/1.1, no client certificate)

tcp.text:
GET /ncc/b HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

steps.note: a TLS forward to itself: the forwarding client offers no ALPN
